facts.statement: The genus Sandalodus was named by Newberry and Worthen in 1866.
Charles Eastman classified Sandalodus within the family Cochliodontidae in 1903.
facts.quote: Charles Eastman classified the genus as a member of Cochliodontidae in 1903

facts.statement: The validity of the genus Sandalodus is debated because some of its species may belong to the same animal as Deltodus.
facts.quote: Some species of the genus have been found to belong to the same animal as Deltodus, and the genus' validity has been questioned

facts.statement: Sandalodus lived during the Late Devonian, Carboniferous, and Permian periods.
facts.quote: Sandalodus is an extinct genus of cartilaginous fish from the Late Devonian, Carboniferous and Permian periods

facts.statement: Sandalodus is classified as a member of the class Chondrichthyes.
Fossils of Sandalodus date from 351.9 to 266.9 million years ago, spanning the Tournaisian to Roadian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Tournaisian to Roadian (351.9 to 266.9 million years ago)
